classification.difficultyReason: Both area formulas are supplied, so the student substitutes into the circle and sector formulas, finds the unshaded part by subtraction, then forms and simplifies a ratio of π-multiples. This links several routine procedures: sector fraction 150/360, keeping answers in terms of π, and complementing the area. There are no unsignposted insights. It is a little more demanding than p61-q13 because of the sector and the π ratio, but it stays within the routine linked-procedure band.

content.prompt:
The shaded region is a sector of a circle.

Area of a circle $=\pi r^2$
Area of a sector $=\dfrac{\theta}{360}\times\pi r^2$

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area of the whole circle, in terms of $\pi$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the area of the shaded sector, in terms of $\pi$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the ratio of the shaded area to the unshaded area, in simplest form.
